correctness.rationale: The proof explicitly computes every rank-one orbit projector for each two-dimensional irreducible. Root-of-unity averaging isolates the diagonal and off-diagonal matrix units for \(m>2\); the \(m=2\) resonance reduces to a two-by-two determinant \(c^2-\overline c^2\). The one-dimensional cases are immediate. The direct replay constructs the actual orbit projectors for all irreducible parameters through \(n=80\) and matches the analytic criteria.
